title: Distinct Ores
description: Each ore keeps its vanilla color but gains a unique geometric vein shape (coal dots, iron diagonal, copper X, gold cross, redstone ring, lapis triangle, diamond rhombus, emerald square) so you can tell them apart at a glance, even in low light.
body:
# Distinct Ores

Vanilla ores mostly differ by **color**, which is a problem in dim light, deep caves, or for color-blind players. **Distinct Ores** gives every ore its **own geometric vein shape**, so you can identify it at a glance even when you can't see the color clearly.

## What the pack changes
- **Coal** - clusters of dots
- **Iron** - diagonal stripe
- **Copper** - large "X" (copper + green patina)
- **Gold** - cross "+"
- **Redstone** - ring
- **Lapis** - triangle (pyramid)
- **Diamond** - rhombus
- **Emerald** - square

## Details
- Covers all 16 ore blocks - both the stone and **deepslate** variant of each ore.
- **16x** resolution, matches the vanilla style (keeps the original ore colors).
- Pure resource pack - no mods, no Fabric, just drop it into `resourcepacks/`.

## Supported versions
Minecraft Java **1.21.8 - 1.21.10**.
